fatal_blockers: Neither verifier reaches ROADMAP L1: no complete brick with COPY tree, fanout diamond, three-COPY cycle, depths 1–3, or exact higher-Lawrence kernel identity is serialized. The claimed progress cannot be promoted beyond the separate signed-permutation lemma.
Both tested realizations fail their preregistered gates. The 54x76 brick has a zero-residual honest-affine malformed exchange, while the 136x142 brick has DROP energy 692 below 2414.

The proposed repair by an added detector is incompatible with honest-equivalence semantics. For full honest vectors h_sab with A h_sab=b_s, Δ=h_000-h_011-h_100+h_111 always satisfies AΔ=0; every linear detector having input-independent targets also annihilates Δ.

Under the proposed binary half-integral anchors, each coordinate of Δ lies in [-2,2], and the average anchor energy of z+Δ and z-Δ is E+4||Δ||²≤17E. Since the local projection is malformed, at least one sign is a zero-residual malformed vector of energy at most 17E, so residual rescaling and additional honest-compatible rows cannot meet a strict 17E gate.

The toric verifier's stated target-only routing mechanism is not implemented: its honest RHS is the same fixed row pattern for every switch setting, while switch settings remain unrestricted coefficient variables. Thus it does not verify a compiler whose prescribed routing is actually fixed through targets.
evidence: Machine verification passed only in the sense that the scripts reproduced their expected counterexamples. Exit zero is not soundness evidence.

The 54x76 verifier exhausts 6560 local signed vectors, certifies the support-eight move as conformally primitive, proves the exact affine identity, and embeds a 92-or-108-energy attack in all 384 tested fibers versus legal energy 76.

The 136x142 verifier confirms common legal energy 142, six local minimum kernel moves, and 5832 physical-only Hamming-one/two nonkernel tests. These are restricted audits, not a complete integer kernel or Graver classification.
The all-zero vector in the larger serialization has exact energy 142+25·22=692, so increasing residual scale can repair only that DROP instance; it cannot affect the zero-residual affine exchange.

Lean proves only that a square integral Gram isometry is a signed permutation. It proves no color preservation, Beneš compiler, Lawrence identity, primitive classification, soundness recurrence, hardness result, or dimension-dependent gap.
